title: Mode solver effective index, field, confinement and power against analytic slab and fiber oracles

fixture.periodic_slab: tests/test_mode_ports.py: symmetric slab, core index 2 (epsilon 4), cladding 1.5 (epsilon 2.25), thickness 0.5 um, wavelength 1.55 um, interface samples at epsilon 3.125, transverse grid h in {0.1, 0.05, 0.025} um over a 4 um box (and boxes 2, 4, 6 um at h = 0.05 um), 4 cells of 0.05 um along the invariant axis, periodic full-vector solver solve_waveguide_modes with normal z, two modes (TE0, TM0), CPU
fixture.homogeneous_check: tests/test_mode_ports.py: uniform epsilon 2.25, 20x16 cells of 0.1 um, wavelength 1.55 um, six modes
fixture.open_slab: tests/test_open_mode_ports.py: CPML mode solver, region 6.4 x 0.5 x 1.6 um, mesh (h, 0.1, h) um for h in {0.1, 0.05, 0.025}, x CPML of 0.8 um physical depth (round(0.8/h) layers), y periodic, z 3 PML layers, core index 1.8 for |x| < 0.4 um in cladding 1.4, wavelength 1.55 um, cladding_epsilon 1.96, two modes, float32, CPU
fixture.open_fiber: tests/test_open_mode_ports.py: step-index fiber core index 2.2 in cladding 1.0, radius 0.4 um, wavelength 1.55 um, region 4 x 4 x 1.6 um, h in {0.1, 0.08} um, x and y CPML of 0.8 um, z 3 PML layers, float32, CPU; tests/test_open_mode_padding.py repeats h = 0.1 um with boxes (4.8, 0.8) and (4.8, 1.0) um against a stored baseline beta
fixture.oracles: benchmarks/open_mode_oracles.py solve_slab (TE and TM even-mode dispersion, root by brentq, fields from continuity) and solve_fiber_he11 (full-vector HE11 characteristic equation); tests/test_open_mode_oracles.py checks the oracles themselves (root residual, interface continuity, Maxwell curl residual by central differences, scale invariance, thin/thick and weak-guidance limits)
fixture.pml: 0.8 um CPML on the open axes; the padding test records the box and PML sensitivity of beta

reference_method: Analytic continuum slab TE/TM dispersion relation solved by root finding (periodic and open solvers) and the analytic full-vector HE11 fiber characteristic equation (open solver); the homogeneous case uses the closed-form discrete periodic Yee dispersion sqrt(epsilon - (2/h sin(pi/N)/k)^2); power normalisation and Gram orthogonality are self-consistency of the same discrete quadrature.

observables.name: slab_neff_absolute_error
observables.definition: |neff - neff_analytic| for TE0 and TM0 of the periodic solver at h = 0.025 um; errors strictly decreasing over h

observables.name: open_slab_beta_relative_error
observables.definition: |Re beta / beta_analytic - 1| of the CPML solver at h in {0.1, 0.05, 0.025} um, corrections shrinking

observables.name: fiber_beta_relative_error
observables.definition: |Re beta / beta_HE11 - 1| of the CPML solver at h = 0.1 and 0.08 um

observables.name: homogeneous_neff
observables.definition: six modes against the discrete periodic dispersion

observables.name: modal_power
observables.definition: mode.power() = 1 and backward().power() = -1; Gram matrix identity

observables.name: leakage
observables.definition: edge energy fraction of the outer three cells (periodic) and collar_energy_fraction (open)

observables.name: box_pml_sensitivity
observables.definition: relative shift of beta with box size and PML depth (padding test)

slab_neff_absolute_error_max.where: tests/test_mode_ports.py; relative 3e-4 at neff about 1.7, tighter than the program's 0.005

fiber_beta_relative_error_max.difference_from_common_criterion: looser than the program's 0.005: the fiber is resolved by 8 to 10 cells across its 0.8 um diameter with a staircase circle; docs/OPEN_MODE_PORTS.md records 0.551 and 0.330 percent at h = 0.1 and 0.08 um

acceptance.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds analytic_mode_neff_relative_error 0.005; the fiber budget is the repository's pre-declared fixture-specific limit and is reported as a difference

error_budget.precision_floor: float64 periodic solver: eigenpair and Maxwell residuals below 1e-4 to 2e-5; float32 open solver: Maxwell residual below 2e-4 and collar energy below 1e-4
error_budget.pml: open solver: 0.8 um CPML fixed across meshes; PML and box sensitivity of beta bounded at 1e-4 by the padding test; the fiber budget of 2 percent absorbs the staircase circle at 8 to 10 cells per diameter

notes: All fixtures run on CPU only; the program's neff limit of 0.5 percent is met by the periodic slab (absolute error below 5e-4) and the open slab (relative beta error below 0.5 percent), while the open fiber keeps its pre-declared 2 percent budget. docs/OPEN_MODE_PORTS.md records finest open-slab errors of 0.150 percent (TE) and 0.0119 percent (TM). No test was added by this case.
